================================================================================
README: 3_Market_Sizing_Database.xlsx
================================================================================
ARTIFACT TYPE: Market Sizing and Growth Projections (Artifact #2)
DATA SOURCES: Industry reports, government statistics, market research firms
TIME PERIOD: 2020-2030 (5-year historical + 6-year forecast)

================================================================================
PURPOSE
================================================================================
Provides comprehensive TAM (Total Addressable Market) data by region and 
category. This is the FOUNDATION for all market sizing calculations and 
revenue projections throughout the analysis.

================================================================================
STRUCTURE & SHEETS
================================================================================

Sheet 1: TAM_by_Market_Category
- Complete TAM matrix: Markets × Categories × Years
- All values in USD millions
- Historical data (2020-2024) and forecasts (2025-2030)
- CAGR calculations for each market-category combination

Sheet 2: Market_Penetration
- Current and projected penetration rates
- Per capita consumption metrics
- Growth trajectory indicators

================================================================================
KEY CODES & DEFINITIONS
================================================================================

MARKET CODES: (Same as Master P&L)
US, UK, DE, AU, CN, IN, BR, MX, SG, AE

CATEGORY CODES:
- SUP = Supplements
- SNK = Snacks
- VIT = Vitamins
- FDR = Functional Drinks

TAM (Total Addressable Market):
- Definition: Total revenue opportunity in a market-category
- Unit: USD Millions
- Scope: All potential sales regardless of current brand penetration
- Includes all competitors and potential market growth

CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate):
- Formula: ((End Value / Start Value)^(1/Years) - 1) × 100
- Period: 2024-2030 (6-year forecast)
- Unit: Percentage

PENETRATION RATE:
- Definition: % of target population using the category
- 2024_Penetration_%: Current market penetration
- 2030_Penetration_%: Projected penetration in 6 years

PER CAPITA CONSUMPTION:
- Definition: Average annual units consumed per person
- Varies by category (supplements: higher, snacks: lower)
- Used for bottom-up TAM validation

================================================================================
MARKET CLASSIFICATIONS
================================================================================

MATURE MARKETS (Established):
- United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Australia
- Characteristics: High penetration, moderate growth (4-8% CAGR)
- TAM: $500M-$3,000M per category

HIGH-GROWTH MARKETS (Emerging):
- China, India, Brazil, Mexico
- Characteristics: Lower penetration, high growth (8-15% CAGR)
- TAM: $300M-$2,500M per category

EMERGING MARKETS (Developing):
- Singapore, UAE
- Characteristics: Variable penetration, moderate-high growth (6-12% CAGR)
- TAM: $100M-$800M per category

DATA QUALITY CHECKS COMPLETED
================================================================================
✓ All TAM values rounded to 2 decimal places
✓ Historical data (2020-2024) shows realistic variance
✓ Forecast data (2025-2030) applies consistent CAGR
✓ CAGR calculations verified for all 40 market-category combinations
✓ TAM values align with Master P&L revenue assumptions
✓ Penetration rates increase logically from 2024 to 2030
✓ Per capita consumption validates against population (Artifact #3)

================================================================================
CALCULATION METHODOLOGY
================================================================================

TOP-DOWN TAM:
TAM = Population × Penetration Rate × Purchase Frequency × Average Price

BOTTOM-UP VALIDATION:
TAM = Per Capita Consumption × Population × Average Price
(Cross-validated in Artifact #6)

CAGR APPLICATION:
TAM[Year] = TAM[2024] × (1 + CAGR)^(Year - 2024)

================================================================================
LINKAGES TO OTHER ARTIFACTS
================================================================================

→ Master P&L (Artifact #1): TAM is basis for all revenue projections

ANALYTICAL APPLICATIONS
================================================================================

CRITICAL ASSUMPTIONS
